paragraphs.en: Upon returning from my work one evening, I saw the little prince perched atop a wall, his legs dangling. He spoke with someone off-screen: "Then you don't remember. This is not the exact spot."
paragraphs.zh: 傍晚我从工作中返回时，看见小王子正坐在墙头，双腿晃荡。他似乎在和屏幕外的某人说话：“那你可记不清了，这并不是确切的位置。”

paragraphs.en: Another voice replied, "Yes, yes! It is the right day, but this is not the place."
paragraphs.zh: 另一个声音回答道：“是的，是的！今天是好日子，但这里不是该去的地方。”

paragraphs.en: Approaching the wall, I saw nothing unusual until the little prince said again, "Exactly. You will see where my track begins in the sand. Wait for me there tonight."
paragraphs.zh: 走近墙边，小王子又说：“没错。你今晚会在沙地上看到我的足迹开始的地方。在那里等我。”

paragraphs.en: Twenty meters away, I still observed no one.
paragraphs.zh: 二十米开外，依旧不见有人。

paragraphs.en: Silence fell before he asked, "Do you have good poison? Will it not make me suffer too long?" My heart ached as I stood frozen, unsure of his meaning.
paragraphs.zh: 他还没开口问，沉默已先降臨。“你有剧毒吗？不会让我痛苦得太久吧？”我心痛地站在原地，不知他话中的含义。

paragraphs.en: "Go away," said the little prince, "I want to get down from the wall." Dropping my eyes, I saw a yellow snake, which slithered across the sand in mere seconds. Grabbing my revolver, I stepped back but missed it as the snake disappeared among the stones with a metallic sound.
paragraphs.zh: “你走开。”小王子说道，“我想从墙上下来。”我低下头，只见一条黄色的蛇在沙地上迅速滑过。我急忙拿起手枪后退了一步，但那条蛇已发出金属般的声音钻进了石头缝隙中。

paragraphs.en: Just in time, I caught the little prince, whose face was pale. "What does this mean?" I demanded.
paragraphs.zh: 就在这时，我及时抓住了脸色苍白的小王子。“这是什么意思？”我脱口问道。

paragraphs.en: "Why are you talking to snakes?"
paragraphs.zh: “你和毒蛇说话干什么？”

paragraphs.en: I removed his golden muffler and moistened his temples, giving him water. He looked at me seriously, hugging my neck. His heart beat like a dying bird's.
paragraphs.zh: 我取下了他的金质围巾，湿润了他的额头，给他喂水。他神情严肃地望着我，紧紧抱住我的脖子。他的心跳如同垂死之鸟的挣扎。

paragraphs.en: "I am glad you found what was wrong with your engine," he said. "Now you can go back home."
paragraphs.zh: “你找到了发动机出问题的地方，我很高兴。”他说，“现在你可以回家了。”

paragraphs.en: He said nothing to my question but added, "I'm returning home today too..."
paragraphs.zh: 他没有回答我的问题，只是添了一句：“我今天也要回家……”

paragraphs.en: His voice was heavy with sadness: "It's much farther... more difficult..."
paragraphs.zh: 他的声音带着悲伤的沉重：“远得多……更艰难……”

paragraphs.en: I realized something extraordinary was happening. Holding him close, as if he were a child, yet it felt like he was rushing towards an abyss.
paragraphs.zh: 我意识到有些不同寻常的事情正在发生。我紧紧抱着他，仿佛他是我的孩子，但又觉得他正朝着深渊奔去。

paragraphs.en: His expression was serious, distant. "I have your sheep and the box, and the muzzle..." He gave me a sad smile.
paragraphs.zh: 他的表情严肃而疏远，“我已经有了你的羊和盒子……还有那个鼻套……”他勉强挤出一个悲伤的微笑。

paragraphs.en: After a long wait, I saw signs of revival in his eyes. "Dear little man," I said, "you're afraid..."
paragraphs.zh: 在一番漫长的等待之后，我看到他眼中渐渐有了些生气。“亲爱的小伙子，”我说，“你害怕……”

paragraphs.en: He admitted it with a light laugh: "I'll be even more afraid tonight..."
paragraphs.zh: 他轻笑着承认：“今晚我会更加害怕……”

paragraphs.en: A sense of irreparable loss washed over me. I couldn't bear the thought of never hearing that laughter again. It was like a spring in the desert to me.
paragraphs.zh: 一种无法弥补的失落感涌上心头，我不忍想象再听不到那种笑声。对我而言，那仿佛是沙漠中的甘泉。

paragraphs.en: "Little man," I said, "I want you to laugh again."
paragraphs.zh: “小家伙，”我说，“我希望你再笑一次。”

paragraphs.en: He replied, "Tonight marks one year... my star will be directly above where I arrived on Earth last year..."
paragraphs.zh: 他回答道：“今晚是一周年……我的星宿将正好位于我去年抵达地球的那个地方正上方……”

paragraphs.en: "Little man," I pleaded, "is this just a bad dream? The snake, the meeting place, and the star..."
paragraphs.zh: “小家伙，”我恳求道，“这仅仅是一个噩梦吗？那条蛇、会面的地方和星星……”

paragraphs.en: But he didn't answer. Instead, he said, "What matters is what we cannot see..."
paragraphs.zh: 但他没有回答，而是说道：“重要的是那些我们看不见的东西……”

paragraphs.en: "Yes, I understand..."
paragraphs.zh: “是的，我明白了……”

paragraphs.en: "It's like with the flower. If you love a flower on a distant star, it makes night skies sweet to look at. All stars are blooming with flowers..."
paragraphs.zh: “就像喜欢那颗遥远星球上的花朵一样，只要你心中有这份情愫，就连夜晚的星空也会变得甜蜜。所有的星星都绽放着花朵……”

paragraphs.en: "Yes, I know..."
paragraphs.zh: “是的，我知道……”

paragraphs.en: "It’s also like water. Because of the pulley and rope, your drink was music. You remember how good it was?"
paragraphs.zh: “这也像水一样。因为有了滑轮和绳索，你的饮料就像音乐一般美妙。你还记得那种感觉吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Yes, I do..."
paragraphs.zh: “是的，我确实……”

paragraphs.en: "And at night you'll gaze at the stars. Where I live is so small that I can't show you my star. It's better this way.
paragraphs.zh: “到了晚上，你就可以仰望星空。我住的地方太小了，连我的那颗星星都看不见。这样也好。”

paragraphs.en: My star will just be one among many for you. And you’ll love all the stars in the sky... they'll all be your friends."
paragraphs.zh: 你的星光只是众多星辰中的一颗，你会爱上天空中的每一颗星星……它们都将是你的好朋友。

paragraphs.en: He laughed again, "Ah, little prince, dear little prince! I love hearing that laughter!"
paragraphs.zh: 他又笑了起来，“啊，小王子，亲爱的 little prince！我最喜欢听你那笑声！”

paragraphs.en: The little prince continued, "All men have the stars, but they mean different things for each person. For travelers, the stars guide their way; for scholars, they pose problems; for businessmen, wealth. But all these stars remain silent.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子继续说道：“每个人都有星星，但对不同的人意义各不相同。对于旅人而言，星星是导航的指引；对于学者来说，星星提出了问题；而对于商人，则意味着财富。然而，这些星星始终保持着沉默。”

paragraphs.en: Only you will have the stars that can laugh."
paragraphs.zh: 只有你才能拥有会笑的星星。

paragraphs.en: "What do you mean?" I asked.
paragraphs.zh: “你是什么意思？”我问道。

paragraphs.en: "In one of those stars, I shall be laughing," he said with a smile. "When you look up at the sky at night, it will seem as if all the stars are laughing. You alone will have stars that can laugh!"
paragraphs.zh: “在其中一颗星星上，我将会笑着看着你们。”他微笑着说，“当你夜晚仰望星空时，仿佛所有的星星都在笑。只有你拥有会笑的星星！”

paragraphs.en: He laughed again. "And when your sorrow is comforted, you'll be content to have known me. We will always be friends, and you'll want to laugh with me.
paragraphs.zh: 他又笑了起来。“等你心中的伤痛得以慰藉，你会甘愿认识我。我们永远是朋友，你会希望和我一起开怀大笑。”

paragraphs.en: Sometimes, you might open your window just for the pleasure of it, and your friends will think you're crazy laughing at night! You’ll say, 'Yes, the stars always make me laugh!'"
paragraphs.zh: 有时候，你可能会为了这种乐趣而打开窗户，在夜晚对着星星笑得前仰后合，朋友们还以为你疯了！“是啊，星星总能让我开怀大笑！”

paragraphs.en: He laughed once more. "It would be as if I had given you a great number of little bells that know how to laugh."
paragraphs.zh: 他又笑了起来，“这就像是给你挂了一串会笑的铃铛。”

paragraphs.en: But he quickly became serious. "Tonight... do not come," he said.
paragraphs.zh: 但他很快变得严肃起来。“今夜……不要来了。”他说道。

paragraphs.en: "I won't leave you," I replied.
paragraphs.zh: “我不会离开你。”我说。

paragraphs.en: "Even though it will look like I'm suffering, even like I’m dying. Don’t come to see that; it’s not worth the trouble..."
paragraphs.zh: “即使我会显得痛苦不堪，甚至仿佛濒临死亡。你不要来看那种情景；那不值得你费这个心。”

paragraphs.en: "I won’t leave you," I insisted.
paragraphs.zh: “我不会离开你。”我坚持道。

paragraphs.en: He was worried about something else. "It's also because of the snake. He mustn't bite you.
paragraphs.zh: 他心里另有担忧。“这也是因为那条蛇。它可不能咬你。

paragraphs.en: Snakes are malicious creatures and might just bite for fun."
paragraphs.zh: 蛇是恶意的生物，说不定会无端咬人。

paragraphs.en: I reassured him, "They have no more poison for a second bite."
paragraphs.zh: 我安慰他：“他们已经没有第二次咬人的毒液了。”

paragraphs.en: That night, he left silently without my noticing. When I caught up with him, he was walking quickly and resolutely. He simply said, "Ah!
paragraphs.zh: 那天晚上，他悄悄离开了，我没有察觉。当我追上他的时候，他已经快步而坚定地走着。他只是脱口道：“啊！”

paragraphs.en: You're here..."
paragraphs.zh: 你终于来了……

paragraphs.en: He took my hand, but he was still troubled. "You should not have come," he said. "You will suffer.
paragraphs.zh: 他握住了我的手，但显然心中仍有顾虑。“你不应该来的，”他说，“你会受苦的。”

paragraphs.en: I'll look dead, and that won't be true..."
paragraphs.zh: “我会装死，但这并不真实……”

paragraphs.en: I remained silent.
paragraphs.zh: 我沉默不语。

paragraphs.en: "It's too far for me to carry this body. It's too heavy."
paragraphs.zh: “我搬不动这具身体，太重了。”

paragraphs.en: Again, no response from me.
paragraphs.zh: 再次沉默，我没有回应。

paragraphs.en: "But it will feel like an old abandoned shell. There is nothing sad about old shells..."
paragraphs.zh: “但它只会感觉像是一个被遗弃的旧壳。没有什么关于旧壳的东西是令人悲伤的……”

paragraphs.en: He seemed a bit discouraged but tried again: "You know, it will be wonderful. I'll see the stars too. All the stars will be wells with rusty pulleys.
paragraphs.zh: 他显得有些沮丧，但还是再次尝试着说：“你知道的，那将会非常美好。我也会看到星星。所有的星星都将变成装有生锈滑轮的井。”

paragraphs.en: They'll pour out fresh water for me to drink..."
paragraphs.zh: 他们会给我不间断地倒新鲜的水让我喝……

paragraphs.en: Neither of us spoke anymore as he began to cry.
paragraphs.zh: 我们都没再说话，他开始抽泣起来。

paragraphs.en: "Here it is. Let me go on by myself."
paragraphs.zh: “这就来了。让我自己走吧。”

paragraphs.en: He sat down in fear and then continued: "You know—my flower... I'm responsible for her. She's so weak!
paragraphs.zh: 他害怕地坐下来，然后继续说道：“你知道——我的花儿……我负责她。她那么虚弱！

paragraphs.en: So naïve! She has four useless thorns to protect herself against the world..."
paragraphs.zh: 真是天真啊！她竟然用四根毫无用处的刺来保护自己免受这个世界的伤害……

paragraphs.en: I too sat down, unable to stand any longer.
paragraphs.zh: 我也坐了下来，再也忍不住站着了。

paragraphs.en: "That is all..." he hesitated briefly before getting up and taking a step. I could not move.
paragraphs.zh: “这就全都说清楚了……”他犹豫了一下，站起身迈步走了出去。我却动弹不得。

paragraphs.en: A flash of yellow near his ankle stopped him in his tracks. He froze for an instant, then fell gently like a tree, making no sound due to the sand.
paragraphs.zh: 一条黄色的光斑在他的脚踝附近一闪，让他突然停下了脚步。他僵立了片刻，然后像一棵树一样缓缓倒下，沙地上传来的声音几乎听不见。
